Aclauses.inferredOperationalization: For a supplied, appropriately labelled MO energy diagram, count electrons occupying bonding and antibonding orbitals and calculate (N_bonding − N_antibonding)/2. This quantifies the net bonding of the expressly prescribed model and makes the same diagram interpretation/existence inference observable. It adds no molecular family, unrelated model or independent comparative-stability topic. The term/formula is didactic operationalization, not an official-source quotation.
Aclauses.independentChemicalCheck: Using valence-only diagrams, O2 has eight bonding and four antibonding electrons, giving bond order 2; N2 has eight bonding and two antibonding electrons, giving 3. Including equally occupied core bonding/antibonding orbitals leaves those values unchanged. Correct diagram-specific sigma/pi ordering and electron occupancy are required; positive formal bond order is a result within this simplified model, not an unconditional general stability theorem.
